verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Calendly automatically adding a Zoom, Google Meet, Teams or native video link to each booking. The 'Joins Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams' line is listed with recordings and transcripts, so it describes the AI notetaker joining existing meetings. That is a related but different feature from generating conference links. Community mentions of automated calendar invites also say nothing about video links.

support.subject: As a founder, every booking gets a video conference link automatically (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video)
